units.source_text: 然而，我的脚并非永远驻在模型前。

en.t: However, my feet did not remain forever before the model.

units.source_text: 父亲顺便把我领到闻名遐迩的国宝义满像前。

en.t: My father also took me to see the famous national-treasure statue of Yoshimitsu.

units.source_text: 这尊木像用了义满削发为僧之后的名字，称为鹿苑院殿道义之像。

en.t: This wooden statue used the name Yoshimitsu took after shaving his head and becoming a monk, and was called the statue of Rokuon-in-dono Dogi.
